run_adsorbml_pipeline: run the AdsorbML pipeline to identify global minima adsorption energy for slab-adsorbate systems
calculate_adsorption_energies: calculate adsorption energies for a subset of structures split across array jobs
write_adsorbml_results: write AdsorbML calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
configure_adsorbml_optimizer: configure the AdsorbMLRunner with a custom optimizer class, force convergence threshold, and max steps
review_adsorbml_runner_class: review the AdsorbMLRunner class that extends CalculateRunner for ML-based adsorption energy calculations
